papers.title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
papers.abstract: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.

summary.takeaway: 提出 BioScore 基准，以同一组织空间转录组为参照，无监督量化病理基础模型图像编码器对 52 种标记基因定义细胞身份的表示能力。
summary.methods: 用稀疏自编码器将 patch 嵌入分解为稀疏特征并聚类成固定组数，再对每种细胞身份衡量某组特征沿组织跟随其表达的特异性；评估 8 个病理基础模型与 3 个自然图像模型，并用配对检验分层。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练主题，涉及病理基础模型的无标签生物学表征评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告病理模型分数 0.299–0.371 高于自然图像模型 0.214–0.232，但未说明基准规模与切片数量对稳定性的影响；BioScore 与监督探针排序一致但不等于下游任务性能。

papers.title: Hierarchical Gene Regulatory Networks Improve Gene Prioritization in TWAS by Constraining Trans-Regulatory Search.
papers.abstract: Transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS) link genetically regulated expression (GReX) to complex traits and provide a widely used framework for prioritizing candidate genes from genome-wide association study (GWAS)signals. However, most TWAS models focus primarily on local cis-regulation, whereas distal trans-regulation remains difficult to incorporate because of the large genomic search space. Here we present GRNTWAS (Gene regulatory network-guided transcriptome-wide association study), a framework that incorporates hierarchical gene regulatory networks (GRNs) to define a biologically constrained space for integrating trans-regulation in TWAS. GRNTWAS prioritizes upstream regulators using graph-guided propagation on regulatory networks and jointly models local cis-variants together with GRN-guided trans-variants to predict gene expression. Across simulations and two transcriptomic cohorts (GEUVADIS and Mayo RNA-seq), GRNTWAS improves both prediction accuracy and the number of predictable genes relative to methods included in the primary benchmarks. Applied to 12 neuropsychiatric traits, GRNTWAS prioritizes genes with biological support, including overlap with genome-wide significant genes in GWAS and enrichment for loss-of-function-intolerant genes. In Alzheimer's disease, GRNTWAS highlights prioritized genes supported by independent transcriptomic, clinicopathological, and perturbational evidence. Together, these results support hierarchical trans-regulatory modeling as an effective strategy for extending TWAS beyond local regulation and improving transcriptome-based gene prioritization for complex traits.

summary.takeaway: GRNTWAS 通过分层基因调控网络约束 trans 调控搜索空间，将 trans 调控整合进 TWAS，提升基因表达预测与复杂性状候选基因优先级排序。
summary.methods: 在调控网络上用图引导传播优先排序上游调控因子，联合建模局部 cis 变异与 GRN 引导的 trans 变异预测基因表达；在模拟数据和 GEUVADIS、Mayo RNA-seq 两个转录组队列中评估，并应用于 12 个神经精神性状和阿尔茨海默病。
summary.relevance: 该工作利用基因调控网络（GRN）来扩展 TWAS 的调控建模范围，直接对应 GRN/Regulon 主题，展示了 GRN 在复杂性状基因优先级排序中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告相对基准方法的改进，未给出具体效应量或独立验证的量化指标；对 trans 调控的整合仍依赖于 GRN 的质量和覆盖度，其泛化性需进一步评估。

papers.title: Shape-Aware Three-Way Merge for RDF Knowledge Graphs: The schema defines the conflict: an implementation and evaluation
papers.abstract: Merging RDF serializations creates ordering conflicts and misses semantic ones. We describe and evaluate a three-way merge in which the schema defines a conflict: set algebra combines canonical triples, and a slot is contended only where a SHACL shape bounds its cardinality and both sides' changes cannot stand within that bound. Unbounded predicates union; contended slots go to a person. The same shapes graph validates the result. We do not claim the first three-way merge for RDF. Our contribution is an implementation in a production multi-agent store and an evaluation against a reimplementation of Quit Store's Context Merge overlap rule, which it extends rather than replaces, and six other strategies. Across five synthetic seeds, the shape-aware operator raised 33 conflicts, all true positives as judged by the same shapes that define them, with no triples lost or fabricated and no SHACL violations admitted. The context-overlap baseline, counted per slot, detected the same 33 conflicts but asked 845 questions. A replay built from recorded production incidents covers 105 human alias repairs (93 after excluding 12 chained pairs) and 939 duplicate-value incidents. It reproduces a triple-level limit: different names for one entity remain invisible (0 of 93 alias repairs detected, matching 0 of 21 synthetic cases). In a study of evolving shape contracts, merging shape declarations first handles the tested cardinality changes, while datatype evolution exposes a detector blind spot caught by post-merge validation. An oracle that reads no shapes agrees with the shipped operator on the facts and history of all 23 reachable single-slot cases. Under wrong shapes, a missing bound loses data silently and a spurious one only adds questions. The supported claim is fewer human decisions with nothing silently lost, for cardinality conflicts in one deployment, not general merge correctness.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种模式感知的 RDF 知识图谱三路合并方法，利用 SHACL 形状定义基数冲突，在减少人工决策的同时避免数据静默丢失，但仅针对基数冲突且不声称通用合并正确性。
summary.methods: 使用集合代数合并规范三元组，仅当 SHACL 形状约束基数且双方变更无法共存时标记冲突；在生产多智能体存储中实现，并与 Quit Store 的 Context Merge 重叠规则等六种策略对比，在五个合成种子和生产事件回放上评估。
summary.relevance: 该研究聚焦知识图谱的合并与冲突检测，直接对应知识图谱主题，尤其涉及 RDF 和 SHACL 在知识图谱维护中的应用。
summary.caveat: 作者明确限制结论范围：仅针对一个部署中的基数冲突，不声称通用合并正确性；不同名称指代同一实体的别名修复仍无法检测（0/93），且数据类型演化存在检测盲点。

papers.title: When to Trust a PFN: Detecting Harmful Shift in Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Tabular prior-fitted networks (PFNs) work well across tabular classification problems but can fail silently at deployment when distributions shift. We propose CALD (Calibrated Anchor-Loss Disagreement), a lightweight unsupervised monitor that triggers an alarm to warn when a PFN might fail. By finetuning the decoder to maximize disagreement with the test-set prediction while maintaining accuracy on an ID anchor set, CALD identifies harmful OOD batches through the resulting anchor loss, requiring no labels on test batches. We prove that the post-finetune anchor loss has a strictly lower expectation under sufficiently severe shift than under ID eval, yielding a one-sided test. Across 14 datasets covering tabular and structured distribution shift, on both TabPFN and TabICL, CALD matches or outperforms baselines on harmful shifts and is markedly more resilient to benign-shift false alarms.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CALD，一种轻量无监督监控器，通过微调解码器最大化与测试预测的分歧并保持 ID 锚集准确率，利用锚损失检测表格 PFN 在部署时可能失败的有害分布偏移。
summary.methods: 在 TabPFN 和 TabICL 上，于 14 个涵盖表格和结构化分布偏移的数据集上评估，无需测试批次标签，并与基线方法比较有害偏移检测和良性偏移误报。
summary.relevance: 该工作关注表格预训练模型（PFN）在分布偏移下的可靠性监测，与预训练主题相关，尤其是预训练模型部署后的安全监控。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体检测性能数值；方法依赖于 ID 锚集和微调解码器，在极端或未知偏移类型下的有效性需进一步验证。

papers.title: ChemoMAE: Self-Supervised Spectral Representation Learning Reveals Chemical Heterogeneity in Historical Wood
papers.abstract: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.

summary.takeaway: ChemoMAE 是一种自监督 Transformer，通过掩码去噪学习像素级光谱表示，无需预定义化学状态类别即可聚类生成空间图，揭示历史木材的化学异质性。
summary.methods: 对日本历史建筑中 49 个木材试样的横截面进行近红外高光谱成像，利用光谱变量间的多重共线性进行掩码去噪自监督学习，聚类表示生成空间图，并提出局部标签一致性（LLA）量化相邻像素标签一致性。
summary.relevance: 该研究采用自监督表示学习处理高光谱数据，直接对应自监督与表示学习主题，展示了自监督在科学发现中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要中提出的降解模型仅为机制性假设，需进一步实验验证；研究样本限于日本历史建筑木材，跨物种和跨环境的泛化性未评估。

papers.title: BoolFunc-EA: A Boolean-evolutionary approach for accurate inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data.
papers.abstract: Network inference is the process of discovering genetic information from time-series data. The inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series data represents a significant challenge in bioinformatics. Despite the development of many Boolean network inference methods, most struggle with scalability as they impose restrictions on regulatory genes for each target gene. Other methods suffer from local optimum issues or are unable to compute the exact mutual information between a regulatory gene and its target gene. To resolve these issues, we present a novel method referred to as BoolFunc-EA, which employs Boolean functions and a genetic algorithm to infer gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data. BoolFunc-EA is a two-stage algorithm. First, we employ a set of limited Boolean functions to search for a regulatory gene. If a regulatory gene is not identified at this stage, a genetic algorithm is applied to determine a set of regulatory genes. In particular, this study introduces a hybrid crossover operator and a new fitness function that enhances information inheritance, improves solution evaluation, and provides a more effective solution representation within the proposed genetic algorithm framework. To assess the effectiveness of BoolFunc-EA, we conducted a wide range of experiments on both artificial and real gene expression datasets. Findings from the artificial dataset reveal that BoolFunc-EA consistently outperforms benchmark methods, including LogicGEP, LogBTF, MIBNI, LBF-MI, CLR, RelNet, Genie3-time, dynGenie3, and Jump3. The proposed method was further evaluated on the budding yeast cell cycle network and on fifty gene regulatory network datasets generated using the GNW tool. Its performance was then compared with that of nine benchmark methods. Results from real gene expression datasets also show that BoolFunc-EA consistently achieves superior F-score values, even on biological networks. Taken together, BoolFunc-EA is an efficient, scalable, and robust tool for gene regulatory network inference. The source code and reproducible experimental results are freely accessible at https://github.com/Dr-Shohag-Barman/BoolFunc-EA.

summary.takeaway: BoolFunc-EA 结合布尔函数和遗传算法两阶段推断基因调控网络，通过混合交叉算子和新适应度函数提升可扩展性和准确性。
summary.methods: 第一阶段用有限布尔函数搜索调控基因，若未识别则第二阶段用遗传算法确定调控基因集合；在人工和真实基因表达数据集（包括 budding yeast 细胞周期网络和 GNW 生成的 50 个 GRN 数据集）上与 LogicGEP、LogBTF、MIBNI、LBF-MI、CLR、RelNet、Genie3-time、dynGenie3、Jump3 等九种基准方法比较。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接针对从时间序列基因表达数据推断基因调控网络，是 GRN/Regulon 主题的核心方法研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在 F-score 上持续优于基准，但未提供具体数值或统计显著性；方法性能可能依赖于布尔函数集合和遗传算法参数的选择，需独立验证。

papers.title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
papers.abstract: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SACK，一种即插即用技术，通过将模型类别知识分解为细粒度概念、计算新旧概念关系并对新样本排序，以提升持续学习中的稳定性和可塑性平衡。
summary.methods: SACK 分解类别知识为细粒度概念，计算先前学习概念与新经验中概念的关系，并据此优先排序新样本；在正则化、回放和基于提示的持续学习方法中，于类增量和任务增量设置下实验。
summary.relevance: 该研究聚焦持续学习中的样本排序策略，直接对应持续学习主题，探索了数据顺序对灾难性遗忘的影响。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体准确率或遗忘率数值；方法依赖于概念分解的质量，在复杂真实场景中的计算开销和可扩展性未讨论。

papers.title: Grounding User Preferences in Shared Multimodal Concepts for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Multimodal recommendation has substantially advanced item understanding by incorporating rich visual and textual content. Yet user preferences are still commonly encoded as implicit signals tied to individual items, leaving recurring semantic factors without persistent identities that can be shared across items. We introduce MKGE, a multimodal knowledge graph framework that represents these factors as canonical, addressable concepts. MKGE induces a domain-adaptive concept vocabulary from item images and titles, grounds each user's interaction history in supported concepts, and jointly models direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals. By turning recurring semantics into shared coordinates, MKGE enables evidence from different items to accumulate around the same preference factors. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that MKGE consistently outperforms collaborative, knowledge-graph, multimodal, and recent LLM/MLLM-based recommenders across all six reported metrics. Controlled studies further demonstrate the importance of canonical concept identities and personalized user-concept correspondence, with especially pronounced gains over removing or rewiring the user graph for low-activity users. These results establish canonical multimodal concepts as effective units for preference modeling and transfer. Code, constructed knowledge graphs, and prompts are available at https://github.com/Garden1a-X/MKGE.

summary.takeaway: MKGE 是一个多模态知识图谱框架，将用户偏好中的重复语义因素表示为规范可寻址概念，联合建模直接用户-物品证据和概念介导的偏好信号，提升多模态推荐性能。
summary.methods: 从物品图像和标题中诱导领域自适应概念词汇，将用户交互历史 grounding 到支持的概念，并联合建模直接和概念介导信号；在三个公开基准上评估，与协同、知识图谱、多模态及近期 LLM/MLLM 推荐器比较。
summary.relevance: 该工作利用多模态知识图谱进行推荐，直接对应知识图谱主题，展示了知识图谱在用户偏好建模中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能提升数值；方法依赖于概念词汇的构建质量，在冷启动或低资源场景下的有效性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Tune for Retention, Not Just Gain: SFT Forgets Far Less than You Think
papers.abstract: Catastrophic forgetting, the drastic loss of previously acquired capabilities when learning new ones, is a central challenge in language model fine-tuning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely believed to be prone to such forgetting. Recent works have attributed this to the off-policy nature of SFT, arguing that on-policy learning is key to continual learning. In this paper, we challenge this premise. We show that while maximizing new-task performance can induce catastrophic forgetting, alternative hyperparameter choices (lower learning rate and batch size) can yield similar gains with little to no forgetting. With hyperparameters selected jointly for gain and retention, vanilla SFT retains prior capabilities far better than previously suggested and can be competitive with Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), an on-policy approach designed to mitigate forgetting. While SDFT can be more robust to hyperparameter choices, it also requires a retention-aware criterion to identify hyperparameter configurations that avoid catastrophic forgetting. Our results challenge the view that on-policy training is what enables learning with retention and raise broader questions about what drives catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.

summary.takeaway: 挑战 SFT 必然导致灾难性遗忘的观点，表明通过联合优化增益和保留的超参数选择（较低学习率和批大小），原始 SFT 可以大幅减少遗忘，并与 on-policy 方法 SDFT 竞争。
summary.methods: 在语言模型微调中，比较不同超参数下 SFT 与 Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) 的增益和保留表现，分析超参数对遗忘的影响。
summary.relevance: 该研究探讨持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与超参数选择，直接对应持续学习主题，对 on-policy 训练的必要性提出质疑。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体实验设置和数据集信息；结论可能依赖于特定模型和任务，需更广泛验证。

papers.title: HEAR, SEE, SPIKE ONCE: Highly Efficient NeuroAI Temporal Neural Networks for Low-Precision Multimodal Audio-Visual Classification and Online Learning
papers.abstract: Spiking neural networks for multimodal audio-visual classification reach high accuracy by adopting deep-learning machinery: multi-stage convolutional or transformer encoders trained end-to-end with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time. These prior works typically rely on full-precision (32-bit) parameters and do not treat hardware efficiency as a primary design objective. In this paper, we propose NeuTNN-AV, a much simpler hardware-amenable multimodal substrate built on the recently proposed NeuroAI Temporal Neural Network (NeuTNN) and demonstrate that it can match or outperform state-of-the-art SNN baselines with a fraction of their synapse counts. NeuTNN neurons carry multiple active dendritic segments. Each input line spikes at most once (temporal coding) and every weight is learned via a local reward-modulated spike-timing dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. All weights are 4-bit integers and inference uses only comparisons and additions. On CREMA-D, it reaches 78.6% with 2.34M synapses establishing a new state-of-the-art SNN accuracy, against 77.14% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). On UrbanSound8K-AV, NeuTNN reaches 98.82% with 1.38M synapses, against 96.85% for SMMT (9.99M parameters) and 98.96% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). Weight memory is 23-106x smaller than the spiking baselines, and the measured synaptic energy per inference is two to three orders of magnitude lower. Furthermore, the proposed NeuTNN learns CREMA-D in a single pass with 73.8% accuracy and demonstrates rapid online continual learning by adapting to unseen actors from a few dozen clips.

summary.takeaway: 提出 NeuTNN-AV，一种基于 NeuTNN 的多模态视听脉冲神经网络，以远少于现有 SNN 基线的突触数量在 CREMA-D 和 UrbanSound8K-AV 上达到或超过其准确率，并支持单遍在线持续学习。
summary.methods: 采用带多个活跃树突段的 NeuTNN 神经元，输入线至多发放一次（时间编码），权重通过局部奖励调制 STDP 学习；全部权重为 4-bit 整数，推理仅用比较与加法。在 CREMA-D 和 UrbanSound8K-AV 上评估，并与 MISNet-XL、SMMT 等 SNN 基线比较突触数、权重内存和突触能耗。
summary.relevance: 该工作强调单遍在线学习与对未见过说话人的快速适应，直接对应持续学习主题中高效在线更新与少样本适应的关注点。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告分类准确率、内存与能耗等指标，未说明持续学习中的遗忘程度、任务序列设置及与专门持续学习方法的对比；在线适应实验规模有限，仅涉及少量片段。
